The '''TTT-54 "Thumper"''', also known as the '''Tees''', was a low tech [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] originally designed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and later licensed to [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] for full production. It had an adjustable grenade housing that allowed it to use a wide variety of munitions, including [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], though the system required recalibration for each new grenade type and could jam if different-sized grenades were stored in the magazine. Unlike comparable models such as the [[MobileMortar-3]] , its range was shorter and it lacked an attached [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] to ease the weight burden.<ref name="AEG" />
